description: Send GA4 web-stream events using the Measurement Protocol and an API secret. A successful response indicates HTTP receipt, not that Google Analytics processed the events.

inputSchema.description: Request model for sending events to Google Analytics 4 via Measurement Protocol.

api_secret.description: Required. The API secret generated in the Google Analytics UI under Admin > Data Streams > Measurement Protocol API secrets. Used to authenticate requests.
api_secret.title: Api Secret

client_id.description: Required. A unique identifier for a user/client. This should be a UUID or similar unique string that identifies a specific user across sessions. Maximum 256 characters.
client_id.title: Client Id

ad_personalization.description: Consent status for ad personalization. Valid values: 'GRANTED', 'DENIED'
ad_personalization.title: Ad Personalization

ad_user_data.description: Consent status for ad user data. Valid values: 'GRANTED', 'DENIED'
ad_user_data.title: Ad User Data

events.description: Required. Array of event objects to send. Maximum 25 events per request. Each event must have a 'name' and can optionally include 'params'.

items.description: Event object for Google Analytics 4 Measurement Protocol.

name.description: Required. Name of the event. Can be up to 40 characters. Use recommended event names from GA4 documentation (e.g., 'purchase', 'login', 'sign_up', 'page_view') or custom event names.
name.title: Name

params.description: Optional. Event parameters as key-value pairs. Common parameters include 'currency', 'value', 'transaction_id', 'items', 'engagement_time_msec'. Can include custom parameters.
params.title: Params

items.title: Event

events.title: Events

measurement_id.description: Required. The measurement ID for the web stream in the format G-XXXXXXX. This is found in the Google Analytics UI under Admin > Data Streams > Web Stream Details.
measurement_id.title: Measurement Id

timestamp_micros.description: Optional. Unix timestamp in microseconds for when the event occurred. If not provided, the current time is used. Can be up to 72 hours in the past.
timestamp_micros.title: Timestamp Micros

user_id.description: Optional. A unique identifier for a logged-in user. This should be a non-PII identifier that you use internally to identify a user. Maximum 256 characters.
user_id.title: User Id

user_properties.description: Optional. User properties to set for this measurement. Each property must have a 'value' field. User properties persist across events.
user_properties.title: User Properties

inputSchema.title: SendEventsRequest

name: send_events

SendEventsResponse.description:
Response model for send events action.
The API returns HTTP 204 No Content on success, so this model represents a successful response.

message.default: Events successfully sent to Google Analytics
message.title: Message

status_code.description: HTTP status code from the API response
status_code.title: Status Code

success.description: Indicates that the events were successfully sent to Google Analytics
success.title: Success

SendEventsResponse.title: SendEventsResponse
